source_scope: User supplied static reverse engineering report; not executable instructions. Independently counted supplied lights_data.json; did not rerun game or extraction.
directly_relevant: Level_Office_01: 65 serialized lights, 56 without shadows, 9 with soft shadows; 1 lightmap set; baked enabled, realtime lightmaps disabled.
Level_Office_06: 65 serialized lights, 54 without shadows, 11 with soft shadows; 5 lightmap sets; baked enabled, realtime lightmaps disabled.
Level_Hotel_11: 100 serialized lights, 93 without shadows, 7 with soft shadows; useShadowmask serialized true.
evidence_limits: Light count is across serialized scenes, not simultaneous active lights. m_Enabled, activeInHierarchy, camera-visible lights, cullingMask, baked-output channels and runtime writes were not exported.

Mixed is not equivalent to zero realtime direct lighting or shadow work. The exact mixed submode is not proven for the office scenes by m_LightmapsMode=1; that field is lightmap directional encoding, not mixed lighting mode.

ReflectionProbe export only counts objects, not mode, refresh/time-slicing or resolution. Offices inspected have zero probe objects but this does not rule out default reflection or screen-space reflection.
Two SSR shader assets exist; resource presence does not prove camera/profile activation or frame cost.
Global deferred tier setting can be overridden per-camera. Report lacks camera runtime path/projection and frame captures.

Main Assembly-CSharp method extraction unavailable; dynamic light pooling/update policy and loading sequence are not proven. Library presence and method names are hypotheses, not measured gameplay behavior.

Office shadow configuration includes only spot/directional types: Office01 7 spots+2 directionals; Office06 10 spots+1 directional, zero shadow-enabled points. This is not a measured simultaneous shadow-pass count.
application_to_perf011: Continue minimal separation of illumination receivers and shadow proxies without removing any C7 shadows, lights or dynamic reflections. Use report to inform a later static-light/shadow budget study; do not replace the current candidate or renderer based on unverified claims.
possible_next_readonly_extraction: Per-Light enabled/active hierarchy, Transform, full m_Shadows, m_CullingMask, m_Lightmapping, m_BakingOutput incl mixed mode and occlusion channel, m_RenderMode and shadow resolution.
Per-Renderer lightmap index/ST, cast/receive shadow flags and static flags; per-LightmapSettings map references and mixed-lighting settings.
Active game camera renderingPath/projection, target textures, enabled postprocessing profiles with SSR parameters; ReflectionProbe mode/refresh/time-slicing/baked references.
Targeted managed method bodies for actual light toggle/flash pooling, visibility update, reflection and loading if independently available; no inference from class names alone.
